subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be exposed as a separate `dmThreadMode` account option, folded into the existing `replyToMode` threading contract, or kept unsupported after the prior invalid-thread fix?
rationale: The code change is small, but the permanent config/API shape and the decision to re-enable DM thread targets after a prior delivery failure need maintainer intent.

options.title: Choose the config API before merge
options.body: Decide the permanent threading option shape first, then require the branch to update types, generated metadata, docs, tests, and real proof for that contract.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` as a new knob
options.body: Treat the separate DM-only option as intentional, but block merge until the config contract and live Google Chat proof are complete.

options.title: Pause or close the opt-in
options.body: Keep the prior group-only DM behavior if maintainers do not want to reintroduce thread targets for direct spaces.

recommendation.title: Choose the config API before merge
recommendation.body: Decide the permanent threading option shape first, then require the branch to update types, generated metadata, docs, tests, and real proof for that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete verified and landed the predecessor DM thread-suppression path and has the strongest recent history on the central Google Chat runtime files.
